description: Independent Muse voice companion for Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Talk to Muse with a pixel companion and live captions.
store.description: Muser is an independent, unofficial community app for Cardputer Zero. Voice conversations, captions, keyboard chat and session-only records on a 320x170 display. English UI by default, with Simplified Chinese available in Settings. Requires a Muse account, SDK token and phone pairing; Muse is not available in every country or region, so confirm that you are in a supported region and that your account works before pairing. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Fn-free navigation with message paging, an in-app key reference, and setup by QR or the displayed IP and port; paste your SDK token in any phone or PC browser, then pair over Bluetooth. Saved pairing is retained while Muse service connections retry.

zh-CN.summary: 像素伙伴、语音对话与实时字幕
zh-CN.description: Muser 是独立开发的非官方社区应用，支持语音、字幕、英文键盘聊天和本次会话记录。英语默认、简体中文可切换；无需 Fn 即可使用消息翻页、按键帮助等导航；App 内扫码在手机粘贴个人 SDK token 后自动蓝牙配对，与 Meta 无隶属或背书关系。Muse 并非在所有地区可用，请在配对前确认你处于支持的地区且账号可用。
